sentences.text: Aashish Shukla vs Arvind Verma on 17 October, 2023

Order Sheet
 M.A. (C) No. 914 of 2020
 Aashish Shukla Versus Arvind Verma & Ors.
17/10/2023 Shri Rakesh Kumar Thakur, Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Ritesh Verma, Counsel for respondent No.1.
Shri Dashrath Gupta, Counsel for respondent no.4.

Heard on I.A. No. 01/2023 which is an
application for condonation of delay of 544 days in filing the appeal.
Though opposed but for the reason mentioned in that application and also considering the delay of 544 days and Motor Vehicle Act is an benevolent legislation, I am inclined to allow this application.
Delay in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.
However the appellant shall not get interest for this period of delay in the event compensation is enhanced by this court.
List it for final hearing in the month of January, 2024.
(Sachin Singh Rajput) Judge Ashish Aashish Shukla vs Arvind Verma on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170162354/
